records.title: Network + decision-model architecture detection (Jev System One)
records.constraint: Network + decision-model architecture detection (Jev System One): Add an opt-in archdetect slice that calls the TypeSafe Jev decision model (~typesafe/jev-latest → typesafe/jev-1.13) over OpenRouter's /api/v1/systemone endpoint. Jev is queried with a single typed choice question, not chat; deep/shallow modules stay a static heuristic. Gated behind detectArchitecture (default false); /vsa detect persists the chosen architecture.
